text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own the VISUAL PRESENTATION of the interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment

name: Facet
text:
Decision: We should make the interface’s main action buttons glow softly when idle, then pulse brighter when hovered or clicked.

Why: A gentle glow keeps the buttons visible without shouting, while the pulse on interaction gives clear feedback that the system is alive and responding. This balances visibility with calmness—users notice what matters without feeling overwhelmed.

Trade-off: The glow adds a small visual load, but we accept that because it prevents users from missing key actions, which would hurt usability more.
